content:
(I hope this hasn't been discussed before; at least I have found nothing on it)
Usually a file has some Main results / Main definitions / Main declarations ... section at the beginning listing a few important theorems for the file.
However, then theorems might be renamed, moved etc., while the "Main results" section mistakenly might not be. This gives declarations in the "Main results" page, which are not actually in that file (at least with that name) anymore.

I ran a script for this (with Codex, I checked the results and they seem good) and it found 306 of such cases.
nonexistentdeclarations.txt

Maybe these can be tracked somehow?

Nice finds! The proper fix for all these is to convert these doc-strings to use verso (which can check for missing identifiers). @Anne Baanen is working on this; the switch should happen very soon. In the mean-time, PRs fixing such mistakes are very welcome.
(Of course, a fix should check if the declaration moved, was simply renamed or something else.)

I reviewed the hits under SimpleGraph:

  • MISSING Mathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Cayley.lean:22: 'SimpleGraph.addCayley' (searched addCayley; section: Main declarations) This is additivized from mulCayley so codex was wrong.
  • MISSING Mathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/DeleteEdges.lean:26: 'SimpleGraph.deleteFar' (searched deleteFar; section: Main definitions) indeed this should be DeleteFar instead.
  • MISSING Mathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/LapMatrix.lean:22: 'isPosSemidef_lapMatrix' (searched isPosSemidef_lapMatrix; section: Main definitions & Results) Should be posSemidef_lapMatrix
  • MISSING Mathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Subgraph.lean:30: 'Lattice' (searched Lattice; section: Main definitions) The line is:
* Instances for `Lattice (Subgraph G)` and `BoundedOrder (Subgraph G)`.

There is an instance below for DistribLattice G.Subgraph which extends Lattice and BoundedOrder (Subgraph G)

  • MISSING Mathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Subgraph.lean:35: 'Subgraph.map_top' (searched map_top; section: Main definitions)
    This is indeed missing and from a quick glance I'm not sure what the original intention was referencing.

  • MISSING Mathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Tutte.lean:18: 'SimpleGraph.TutteViolator' (searched TutteViolator; section: Main definitions) Should be IsTutteViolator

I made a PR with the simple fixes from above, but this seems like something that instead of just catching, codex may be suited for suggesting the correct fixes as well when e.g. the correct name is just an obvious rename in the same file. I presume this would fix a majority of the errors and it seems like a good use of AI with some additional human review to submit fix PRs.
